models.forward: H1=ReLU(S W0+b0); H2=ReLU(S H1 W1+b1); h=mean_nodes(H2); logit=h w+b
models.head: linear
models.loss: unweighted binary cross entropy with logits
models.seed_rule: same initialization/dropout stream for arms in a given fold/inner role; independent outer contexts; frozen hash seeds
models.inner_selection: equal validation-site macro Brier across all inner predictions
models.tie_rule: within 1e-10 prefer larger weight decay, then fewer epochs

scope: Secondary ASD cross-disorder methodological replication, NOT independent MDD clinical validation
paper1_overlap: Same ABIDE derivatives and temporal-null methodology as Paper 1, submitted to Array; new trained predictive endpoints only. Added after observing REST results; not part of original primary study.
primary: Equal-center GNN Brier temporal minus training-rank-budget, primary seed only; negative favors temporal. No equivalence margin or automatic superiority claim.

preprocessing.first190: rows 0:190 of already preprocessed derivatives; no additional volume discard
preprocessing.native230_adapter_name: first230 = rows 0:230, NOT full original run
preprocessing.normalization: Frozen Pearson sample standardization within person and segment; same largest full-FC eigenvalue scaling across arms
preprocessing.phase_null: B100 pooled .99; frozen DC/Nyquist convention; recomputed for every segment; seed from source hash and context
preprocessing.length_scope: retained derivative volumes, not equal physical duration; whole-run preprocessing precedes segmentation

validation: 5 held-center folds, GroupKFold(3) inner roles explicitly frozen; training-only scaler, rank budget and tuning. No mixed-site analysis or target adaptation.

seed_protocol.function: common.seed with fixed ABIDE_REPLICATION_20261028 namespace; exact fold seeds in participant_roles.json

confounding.baseline: Age, recorded sex (male indicator), provider mean FD; training-only StandardScaler and logistic C grid with same inner macro Brier selection
confounding.low_motion: Evaluate existing primary predictions for provider func_mean_fd <=0.2; no refitting; report center/class counts and conditional scope
confounding.associations: Descriptive within-center probability correlations with age and mean FD, plus sample demographic summaries; no causal disease-specific claims

statistics.paired: Same resamples for all model comparisons; within-center diagnosis-stratified and separate center-cluster resampling
statistics.scope: Conditional on fitted predictions; omits training-sample and selection variability; five centers limits primary inference and three centers limits stability inference
statistics.secondary: AUC, Brier, log loss, threshold0.5 balanced accuracy, calibration, stability and operator identity
statistics.stability: Pooled mean absolute probability change first230 versus first190, plus fixed last190 replay; equal-center summaries also reported
statistics.calibration: Pooled diagnostic intercept/slope using frozen metrics implementation; no recalibration; site slopes suppressed unless >=50 per class; 2000 pooled stratified fixed-score calibration resamples with failure counts
statistics.collapse: Report probability range<=1e-7 as constant; also range<=1e-4, standard deviation and all-one-class predictions; retain all results
statistics.multiplicity: Only primary GNN temporal-budget Brier contrast is primary; all other intervals descriptive, not a significance search

limits.stop: One fixed experiment. Stop on unresolved identity/atlas/leakage/integrity errors; repair execution errors only with recorded provenance. No architecture, dataset, atlas, GSR or grid expansion after results.
